scripts.ui:build: bash scripts/build-css.sh && pnpm exec bun build src/ui/index.tsx --target browser --outdir out --sourcemap=external --minify --entry-naming bundle.[ext] --asset-naming bundle.[ext]
scripts.ui:watch: bash scripts/build-css.sh && pnpm exec bun build src/ui/index.tsx --target browser --outdir out --sourcemap=external --entry-naming bundle.[ext] --asset-naming bundle.[ext] --watch
scripts.test: pnpm run build && pnpm exec bun test
scripts.serve:dev: pnpm exec bun index.ts stop 2>/dev/null; pnpm exec bun --watch index.ts serve --foreground --no-open --port ${PORT:-7777}
scripts.deploy: pnpm run build && rm -rf ~/bin/cortex && cp bin/cortex ~/bin/
scripts.style: node node_modules/@biomejs/biome/bin/biome check --write . && pnpm exec tsc --noEmit
scripts.style:check: node node_modules/@biomejs/biome/bin/biome check . && pnpm exec tsc --noEmit
